info.name: X-Group Feedback API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for testing the X-Group Feedback System API.

## Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Set the `BASE_URL` collection variable if needed (default: http://localhost:5000/api/v1)
3. Run **Login — Super Admin** first to auto-populate tokens
4. Use the **Login — Branch Manager** request to set `BRANCH_MANAGER_TOKEN`
5. Use the **Login — Admin** request to set `ADMIN_TOKEN`

## Notes
- Refresh tokens are stateless (JWT-only, no DB storage). Logout is handled client-side by discarding the token.
- The POST /auth/logout and POST /auth/refresh-token endpoints still work via cookies for convenience.
